name: Makoto Franper
source:
"Hehe, I'm fine. Just embarrassed!"

A Japanese girl with a youthful disposition, who is often seen hanging out with [url=/c94030]Mary[/url] and [url=/c94033]Charlie[/url]. She has a sunny personality, but she frustrates Mary with her frequent misinterpreting of social situations. Because she suffered abuse at the hands of her relatives, she is terribly insecure about what others think of her, but she is never one to voice such feelings.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request-2/chara/?page=makoto]official page[/url]]
